title: Automatic crossover valves.
officialText:
Each high- and intermediate-pressure zone in a refrigerating system shall be provided
with a single automatic valve providing a crossover connection to a lower pressure zone. Such automatic crossover valves shall
comply with Sections 1105.9.1.1 through 1105.9.1.3.
